title: File:Auditorium at Maxim in May 2024.jpg
desc: An interior view of one of the two auditoriums at the Maxim film theatre in central Helsinki, Finland showing the large and plush armchairs that serve as the seats. This is a picture only of the physical auditorium, not of the film.
